adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the code updates the external calendar via `eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking)` but constructs `EventManager` using the *caller* (`ctx.user`) and `getUsersCredentials(ctx.user)` (lines near 146–154). The booking owner’s credentials are fetched via `include: { user: { include: { credentials: true }}}` in the initial `prisma.booking.findFirst` (around line 38) but are never used. If a team admin/owner or an attendee (both allowed by the permission checks) triggers this mutation, they likely won’t have access to the organizer’s external calendar event, so the calendar update can fail or be a no-op and guests won’t appear on the real invite.
